title: JKSSB recruitment irregularities: Aspirants hold peaceful protest in Ramban

ai.summary: Aspirants protesting JKSSB recruitment irregularities demand transparent selection process, citing paper leaks and malpractice that have left thousands unemployed.

facts.claim: Aspirants preparing for various recruitment examinations conducted by the Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) staged a peaceful protest in Ramban
facts.quote: Unemployed youth and aspirants preparing for various recruitment examinations conducted by the Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) on Tuesday staged a peaceful protest in Ramban

facts.claim: Repeated allegations of examination paper leaks, malpractice and other irregularities have eroded confidence in the recruitment agency
facts.quote: repeated allegations of examination paper leaks, malpractice and other irregularities had severely eroded the confidence of aspirants in the recruitment agency

facts.claim: Aspirants preparing for JKSSB examinations for five years failed to see meaningful outcomes
facts.quote: he had been preparing for JKSSB examinations for the past five years, expressing disappointment over the recruitment process, saying that despite years of hard work and financial sacrifices, he failed to see any meaningful outcome

facts.claim: Over a dozen persons reportedly arrested in connection with the case
facts.quote: over a dozen persons reportedly arrested in connection with the case and the investigation still underway

facts.claim: Young people from economically weaker sections are worst affected by recruitment controversies
facts.quote: young people from economically weaker sections were the worst affected whenever recruitment examinations were compromised

ai.background_note: Aspirants in Jammu and Kashmir are protesting recruitment irregularities with JKSSB, demanding transparency in the selection process for government jobs.
